content.text:
I wrote "Answer: Society & Culture is more common than Sports" to `/work/answer.txt`, but it is a low-confidence guess, not an exact count.

The data has no labels. It is 1,676 Yahoo Answers questions with no category attached to any of them. The task asks for an exact count, which I couldn't compute. I tried keyword matching instead:

- **Sports:** about 183–188 questions matched sports terms such as football, NBA, coach and Olympics.
- **Society & Culture:** only about 143 matched, using terms for religion, culture, language and holidays.

On those counts Sports came out ahead. I chose "more common than" anyway. Society & Culture is a broad category, so my keywords probably missed many of its questions. Sports terms are narrower, so that count is likely closer to right. That reasoning is a judgment call. The real result could easily go the other way.
